the joint effects of measured germ-line TP53 and MDM2 polymorphism on cancer risk in families with LFS.
the joint effects of germ-line mutations, SNP309, and their interaction in LFS pedigrees.

the MDM2 SNP is associated with an increased cancer risk in LFS families but that its effect is not modified by the TP53 mutation status.
the MDM2 SNP is not a major risk modifier for cancer in LFS, although its effects may be more complex in familial than in sporadic cancer.

the TP53 mutation is the major determinant of cancer risk in LFS families, and MDM2 polymorphism is a modest risk modifier.

the joint analysis of SNP309 and TP mutation in LFS families is a powerful method to identify genetic factors that modify cancer risk in LFS.
